title: Typo: badnwidth instead of bandwidth in getfilejob.cpp
description:
getfilejob.cpp line 225: qCWarning(lcGetJob) << u"Out of badnwidth quota" — should be "bandwidth". Typo regression introduced in this PR.

Fix: Correct the typo.
close_reason: done

title: Report native FileProvider status and domain cleanup failures
description: Tray success currently reflects account connectivity rather than native domain or transfer errors. --clear-fileprovider-domains reports success even on errors/timeouts. Surface native failure state and return failure exit status for unsuccessful CLI cleanup.
close_reason: Native registration/connection/configuration failures now drive provider readiness and tray errors; cleanup CLI returns failure on query/removal/timeouts. testfileproviderlifecycle covers failure status, stale acknowledgments and CLI errors; final CTest passed.

title: WebDAVError-to-NSFileProviderError mapping repeated 3 times with divergent cases
description:
FileProviderExtension.swift lines 519, 634, 803: Three switch webdavError blocks mapping WebDAVError to NSFileProviderError with slightly different case coverage. createItem (line 634) is missing permissionDenied case. Divergence is a bug risk.

Fix: Extract a single shared mapping function.
close_reason: Centralized WebDAV-to-FileProvider error translation and reused it across enumeration and operations, including permission failures. Error mapping regressions in test_fileprovider_webdav.swift passed in final CTest.

title: Investigate recovery of errors for locally discarded unsynced Finder creates
description: Public FileProvider callbacks do not guarantee a provider deletion event for a failed new item discarded locally before receiving a server ID. Status conservatively retains the failed create until a matching retry, confirmed parent removal, sign-out or process restart. Investigate native pending-set behavior with a signed fixture and a safe authoritative signal before clearing these errors. Do not broadly clear failed uploads on unrelated refresh or an empty pending snapshot.

title: Recover FileProvider conflicts with explicit conflict copies
description: Conditional uploads now preserve remote edits and local contents on HTTP412. Finder receives cannotSynchronize and may remain pending. Add conflict-copy recovery with tests for concurrent edits, rename collisions, and reimport.
close_reason: Conditional upload conflicts now create explicit unique conflict copies with If-None-Match:* while preserving remote content; rename collisions return recoverable collision errors. WebDAV regressions cover original-path preservation, conflict identity/naming and Unicode limits; final CTest passed.

title: OUT-OF-SCOPE: Thread-unsafe shared static state in FileProviderExtension
description:
FileProviderExtension.swift lines 33-64: _sharedWebDAVClient and _sharedIsAuthenticated are plain static var properties accessed from multiple extension instances without synchronization. Data race risk.

Fix: Add actor isolation or serial dispatch queue.
close_reason: PR review isolated per-domain state under NSLock and replaced plaintext preferences with per-domain Keychain storage. Legacy plaintext values are removed; universal extension build passes.

title: Expose project and shared spaces in macOS on-demand mode
description: FileProviderXPC only forwards the personal space DAV path. The default on-demand provider does not expose other account spaces. Add domains or a stable virtual hierarchy for project/shared spaces and test account/space removal.
close_reason: Canonical project domain IDs now use allowed dot separators with legacy parsing retained. Real signed native test registers the full UUID-dollar-UUID-derived ID and verifies old colon IDs are rejected; desktop build, 3 focused CTests, and full signed Finder suite pass.

comments.author: eli
comments.text: Reopened: Full-client test account revealed macOS rejects colon-delimited project domain identifiers. Replacing separators and adding a real signed native registration regression before completion.

title: Raw milliseconds instead of chrono literals in FileProvider .mm files
description:
fileprovider_mac.mm line 96: QTimer::singleShot(1000, ...) and fileproviderxpc_mac.mm line 53: setInterval(4 * 60 * 1000). Also line 496: QTimer::singleShot(3000, ...). Should use std::chrono literals per project convention.

Fix: Use 1s, 4min, 3s etc.
close_reason: Converted native FileProvider timer durations to std::chrono seconds/minutes. Desktop build and lifecycle timeout regressions passed.

title: DRIFT: propagateupload.h changes unrelated to FileProvider VFS
description:
propagateupload.h adds an empty Q_SIGNALS: section and a logging category declaration with no FileProvider connection.

Fix: Split into a separate PR or remove.
close_reason: Reverted unrelated propagateupload.h changes; file now has no diff against origin/main. Desktop build and final testdownload passed.

title: Mixed QLatin1String and u-string literal styles in utility_unix.cpp
description:
utility_unix.cpp lines 112-122: Mixes QLatin1String(...) with u"..." style string literals in the same desktop entry formatting block. Three values use u"..." (false, false, true), rest use QLatin1String.

Fix: Pick one style and be consistent.
close_reason: Reverted the unrelated Linux desktop-entry refactor, removing its mixed literal styles; utility_unix.cpp exactly matches origin/main.

title: Auth type guessed from password string heuristic
description:
FileProviderExtension.swift line 892: let useBearer = password.count > 100 || password.hasPrefix("ey") — fragile heuristic to detect OAuth tokens. The main app already knows the credential type.

Fix: Pass the auth type explicitly from the main app via XPC.
close_reason: done

title: accessToken() publicly exposed — confirm if intentional
description:
httpcredentials.h line 63: QString accessToken() const is public. HttpCredentialsAccessManager is already a friend class (line 46). May be intentionally public for other callers.

Fix: Low priority — consider restricting if no external consumer exists.
close_reason: Moved accessToken() to private access and granted the specific FileProviderXPC friend access needed for native authentication. Desktop build passed.

title: dispatch_group_wait(DISPATCH_TIME_FOREVER) blocks thread indefinitely (4 sites)
description:
fileproviderdomainmanager_mac.mm lines 132, 321, 335 and fileproviderxpc_mac.mm line 301: Four dispatch_group_wait(group, DISPATCH_TIME_FOREVER) calls block the calling thread indefinitely. If any NSFileProviderManager completion handler never fires, the thread hangs forever. The XPC one (line 301) is triggered from the main thread via QTimer.

Fix: Use a timeout or dispatch to a background queue with async completion.
close_reason: done

title: Bound FileProvider change journal and paginate cancellable enumeration
description: Persistent change journal fixes anchor loss but grows without retention. Introduce a minimum valid anchor and syncAnchorExpired for pruned history. Enumerators refresh all known directories and invalidate does not cancel tasks. Add paging/cancellation and large-domain tests.
close_reason: Bounded the persistent journal with minimum valid anchors, expired-anchor recovery, paginated items/changes and cancellation. Database retention tests and 1,203-item enumeration/page/cancellation regressions passed in final CTest.

title: Download + DB update block duplicated in fetchContents
description:
FileProviderExtension.swift lines 414-456 and 479-507: The download-update-DB-signal sequence (~25 lines) is duplicated between the happy path and the 401-retry path, differing only in variable names (tempFile vs retryFile, webdav vs freshWebdav).

Fix: Extract the common sequence into a helper method.
close_reason: Extracted fetchContents download/database/signal work into downloadContents and removed the duplicated authentication-retry sequence. Signed Finder hydration and final WebDAV/database CTest passed.

title: deleteDirectoryAndSubdirectories O(n) queries with no transaction
description:
ItemDatabase.swift lines 255-275: deleteDirectoryAndSubdirectories uses BFS traversal with individual SELECT queries per directory node and individual DELETE queries per item. No transaction wrapping — if any delete fails partway, the database is left inconsistent.

Fix: Use a recursive CTE or LIKE query in a single transaction.
close_reason: done

title: sqlite3_column_text crash on NULL columns in ItemDatabase.swift (10 sites)
description:
ItemDatabase.swift lines 383-411: 10 occurrences of String(cString: sqlite3_column_text(stmt, col)) with no nil guard. sqlite3_column_text returns NULL for SQL NULL values; passing NULL to String(cString:) is undefined behavior. The code correctly guards the nullable statusError column (lines 418-423) but not the NOT NULL columns.

Fix: Use a helper function with nil guard.
close_reason: done

title: Verify macOS sync-mode switching in a signed app
description: Smoke-test the provider-selection change with a signed app and a test account: default on-demand access, new account authentication, switch to traditional folders, return to on-demand, relaunch persistence, existing local edits and saved folder configuration. Verify a failed domain disconnection leaves traditional sync stopped. Automated checks cover inactive folder preservation and preference behavior; no live account/domain switch was performed during development.
notes: User confirmed latest stable ~/Applications/OpenCloud Development.app opens without a Keychain prompt and remains logged in. Both General Settings switches plus restart worked; user returned to on-demand. Screenshot exposed separate credential-generation persistence failure blocking actual VFS authentication. Keep this task open until provider recovery/full-client state is verified.
close_reason: User verified both General Settings sync-mode switches with restart and returned to on-demand. Stable Developer ID installation retained saved login without another Keychain prompt; later credential persistence fix verified in live client.

title: FileProvider Swift bug fixes: NULL crash, O(n) queries, auth type protocol
description: Umbrella for Swift side fixes: bd-20k (sqlite3_column_text NULL crash in ItemDatabase.swift), bd-1zv (deleteDirectoryAndSubdirectories O(n) queries + no transaction), bd-1u7 Swift side (update ClientCommunicationProtocol.h and FileProviderExtension.swift to receive auth type). File area: shell_integration/MacOSX/OpenCloudFinderExtension/.
close_reason: ItemDatabase.swift: fixed sqlite3_column_text NULL crash (10 sites, bd-20k) and replaced O(n) recursive delete with single CTE transaction (bd-1zv). bd-1u7 (auth type/protocol changes) is out of this agent's file scope.

title: Do not request unsupported recycle APIs for the virtual Shares location
description: Live personal VFS sync succeeds but virtual Shares reports server unreachable. OpenCloud ShareStorage provider supports normal Stat/ListContainer but its ListRecycle is unimplemented and DAV maps it to HTTP500. Provider wrongly advertises Trash by endpoint shape and refreshes it before the live working set. Keep Shares on-demand support while excluding unsupported virtual-space Trash/search capabilities. Verify both actual account locations reach current status.
close_reason: Virtual Shares no longer advertises or calls unsupported recycle/search APIs. Existing domain capabilities update in place. Native lifecycle and signed capability readback pass; personal and Shares domains both record successful live synchronization.

title: ARC not enabled for new Obj-C++ FileProvider files
description:
CMakeLists.txt line 159: ARC (-fobjc-arc) only enabled for socketapisocket_mac.mm. The 3 new FileProvider .mm files (fileproviderdomainmanager_mac.mm, fileprovider_mac.mm, fileproviderxpc_mac.mm) use manual retain/release.

Fix: Enable ARC for the new .mm files, or document why manual memory management is intentional.
close_reason: Enabled ARC for 3 FileProvider .mm files: added compiler flags in CMakeLists.txt, converted manual retain/release to ARC bridging casts in fileproviderxpc_mac.mm, removed manual memory management in fileproviderdomainmanager_mac.mm. Work done by arc-builder on branch overstory/arc-builder/bd-2p7 (commit c37d21499).

title: C++/ObjC++ bug fixes: typo, ownership, dispatch_group timeouts, XPC auth sending
description: Umbrella for C++ side fixes: bd-11a (getfilejob.cpp typo), bd-842 (syncengine.h revert to unique_ptr), bd-1vt (dispatch_group_wait timeouts in .mm files), bd-1u7 C++ side (pass auth type via XPC). File area: src/libsync/ and src/gui/macOS/.
close_reason: done

title: OUT-OF-SCOPE: OAuth token stored in plaintext UserDefaults
description:
FileProviderExtension.swift line 238: defaults.set(password, forKey: credKeyPassword) stores OAuth bearer token in UserDefaults (a plist file on disk) instead of Keychain. Security concern for follow-up.

Fix: Migrate token storage to Keychain.
close_reason: PR review isolated per-domain state under NSLock and replaced plaintext preferences with per-domain Keychain storage. Legacy plaintext values are removed; universal extension build passes.

title: Enable ARC for FileProvider .mm files
close_reason: Enabled ARC for FileProvider .mm files: added compiler flags, converted to bridging casts, removed manual memory management

title: Fix full-client App Group credential-generation persistence
description: Live signed full client reports Could not persist the on-demand credential generation. NSUserDefaults suite synchronize returns false even as App Group plist generation keys update. Native cfpreferences log rejects AnyUser with container. Host aborts credential RPC, leaving both domains unauthenticated. Isolated signed probe did not assert synchronize result. Fix durable shared marker persistence without weakening stale-generation or removal guards; reproduce and verify in full stable signed client.
close_reason: Exact current-user/any-host preference writes and readback fixed the signed full-client failure. Personal Finder location now enumerates files and records checked/synced dates. Strict signed fixture verifies immediate stale-generation rejection, cleanup, restart, and fresh sign-in; three C++ lifecycle/provider-selection suites pass.

title: Confirm intent: _device->close() removed from GETFileJob::finished()
description:
getfilejob.cpp: _device->close() call and its explanatory comment removed from the normal finished() path. Header says "DOES NOT take ownership of the device" (line 29), so caller owns lifecycle. May be by-design, but the removal of the comment suggests it was accidental.

Fix: Confirm intent, or restore the call.
close_reason: Restored GETFileJob device close behavior and comment by reverting the unrelated getfilejob.cpp drift. File matches origin/main and final testdownload passed.

title: HTTP 403 permissionDenied incorrectly mapped to insufficientQuota
description:
FileProviderExtension.swift lines 524-525 and 809-810: case .permissionDenied maps to NSFileProviderError(.insufficientQuota). HTTP 403 (Forbidden) mapped to quota error — users see "not enough storage" when the real problem is a permission issue.

Fix: Map to an appropriate permission-related error code.
close_reason: Fixed independently of the error-mapping deduplication follow-up: 403 uses Cocoa permission errors, 401 authentication and 507 quota stay distinct. Regression assertions pass.

title: Add native FileProvider lifecycle and XPC failure tests
description:
~1,100 lines of new C++ in src/gui/macOS/fileprovider*.h with zero test coverage in test/.

Fix: Add unit tests for the new FileProvider C++ classes.
notes: Added provider selection, actual shutdown/deleteAccount signal coverage, and native socket lifetime test. Remaining gap is mocked/native domain registration, cleanup timeout, and XPC reconnection behavior.
close_reason: Added native lifecycle/XPC regression suite covering per-space domains, deferred callbacks, owner destruction, cleanup ACK/failure/timeouts, wrong endpoints, missing-extension fallback and CLI errors. testfileproviderlifecycle and all 11 final CTest targets passed; signed XPC/Finder runtime checks also passed.

title: Remove 49 NSLog debug scaffolding calls alongside Logger
description:
49 NSLog calls across 6 files in FileProviderExt/: FileProviderExtension.swift (22), LocalSocketClient.m (16), ClientCommunicationService.swift (4), FileProviderEnumerator.swift (4), WebDAVXMLParser.swift (2), WebDAVClient.swift (1). These duplicate the existing Logger infrastructure. Some log every enumerated item individually.

Fix: Remove NSLog calls before merge.
close_reason: Removed duplicate NSLog debug scaffolding from Swift provider, enumeration, WebDAV and socket paths. Only the invalid-socket-path error diagnostic remains; desktop/universal builds and socket CTest passed.

title: Empty Q_SIGNALS: section in propagateupload.h
description:
propagateupload.h line 62: Q_SIGNALS: section with no signals declared between it and private:. Dead code.

Fix: Remove the empty Q_SIGNALS: section.
close_reason: Removed the empty Q_SIGNALS section by restoring propagateupload.h to origin/main; desktop build passed.

title: Preserve item identity when WebDAV servers omit oc:id
description: FileProvider uses path-derived IDs when oc:id is absent. Rename/reparent changes identity, and MOVE retry cannot safely match destination after source404. Add persistent path-to-ID reconciliation and regression tests for files and directory descendants, including restart/cache recovery.
close_reason: Persisted fallback item identities with rename/descendant reconciliation and recovery sidecar. Enumerator/WebDAV regressions cover idless moves, deleted-cache recovery, path reuse and MOVE retry; final CTest passed.

title: HydrationDevice buffer size reduced ~100x without documentation
description:
hydrationdevice.cpp line 18: BufferSize changed from 4_MiB to ChunkSize * 10 (40 KiB). Flush threshold drops from 3.6 MiB to 4 KiB, resulting in ~900x more CF_OPERATION_TYPE_TRANSFER_DATA calls. No comment explains the rationale. This is a Windows cfapi change unrelated to macOS FileProvider.

Fix: Add a comment explaining the rationale, or revert if unintentional.
close_reason: Reverted the unrelated buffer-size reduction with the Windows cfapi drift; hydrationdevice.cpp exactly matches origin/main.

title: Avoid full FileProvider reimport on unchanged credential refresh
description: setupDomainAccount calls reimportItems below root whenever C++ refreshes credentials. Separate credentials refresh from initial setup/root changes so routine token refresh does not reimport an unchanged tree; retain offline and restart correctness tests.
close_reason: Account setup now distinguishes credential refresh from initial/root changes and no longer reimports the unchanged tree. Signed Finder tests passed offline hydration and eviction/relaunch Keychain restoration; final desktop and universal builds passed.

title: DRIFT: hydrationdevice.cpp changes target Windows cfapi not macOS
description:
hydrationdevice.cpp reduces buffer size from 4 MiB to 40 KiB in the Windows Cloud Files API plugin. Nothing to do with macOS FileProvider.

Fix: Split into a separate PR.
close_reason: Reverted Windows cfapi hydration buffering changes; hydrationdevice.cpp now has no diff against origin/main. This removes the unrelated platform behavior change from the PR.

title: Notarize and publish v0.3 after Apple developer agreement renewal
description: Release v0.3 is prepared as a GitHub draft authored by restot at tag c4595c0c1. Signed arm64 DMG and SHA256SUMS are attached. Apple notarytool using profile OpenCloud rejects authentication with HTTP403: required team agreement missing or expired. Account Holder must accept the agreement before submission. Then notarize the DMG, staple and validate its ticket, regenerate SHA256SUMS, replace draft assets and signing text, and publish. Local artifact: /tmp/opencloud-release-v0.3/OpenCloud-v0.3-macOS-arm64.dmg. Draft: https://github.com/restot/opencloud-desktop/releases. User was asked to resolve the agreement or explicitly choose unnotarized publication.
close_reason: Published v0.3 as restot after Apple accepted notarization dcc9a298-df69-4a9c-826e-d0ae48c70160. Stapled ticket validates; Gatekeeper reports Notarized Developer ID; DMG checksum verified. Replaced both release assets and verified GitHub SHA-256 digests before publishing. Release: https://github.com/restot/opencloud-desktop/releases/tag/v0.3

title: DRIFT: getfilejob.cpp changes unrelated to FileProvider VFS
description:
getfilejob.cpp changes (typo, _device->close() removal) are behavioral changes to the core sync engine, not FileProvider-specific.

Fix: Split into a separate PR.
close_reason: Reverted unrelated GETFileJob changes; getfilejob.cpp now has no diff against origin/main. Final testdownload passed.

title: Retry credential erasure when a disconnected extension is unavailable
description: Sign-out/deletion waits up to3 seconds for Keychain/database cleanup acknowledgment before native removal. On failure the domain stays persistently disconnected; orphan discovery retries through verified XPC. macOS may refuse services for disconnected domains, leaving Keychain data until reachable. Validate signed behavior and provide a reliable cleanup recovery path.
close_reason: Persist removal tombstones and revocation generations before XPC cleanup. Extension startup sweeps pending Keychain/database cleanup before restore; bounded ACK failure preserves disconnected domains and durable retry markers. Native timeout/race tests and signed cleanup/revoked-generation/fresh-signin tests passed.

title: Make macOS on-demand files and traditional folder sync mutually exclusive
description: Default to the existing macOS FileProvider extension when available. Add a persistent traditional folder sync setting, switch at restart, preserve inactive folder configuration, and disconnect FileProvider before starting traditional sync.
close_reason: Implemented default on-demand mode, restart-based traditional sync selection, domain disconnection, preserved inactive folders, and matching setup/account/tray UI. macOS build and both targeted CTest suites pass. Signed-app smoke testing is tracked separately in bd-22q.

title: Verify provider fallback with previously registered incompatible extensions
description: prepareForFolderSync skips native disconnection when extension unavailable/incompatible. Domains created by an older compatible app may persist. Reproduce upgrade/downgrade scenario with signed builds and preserve exclusive-provider behavior.
close_reason: Always query/disconnect native domains before legacy startup. Durable domain history permits clean missing-extension fallback but blocks unknown or previously active domains without disconnect proof. Signed probes confirmed missing-extension API ambiguity; native lifecycle regressions cover all ledger branches.

title: getPropagator() unused test accessor with weakened ownership
description:
syncengine.h lines 128, 214: _propagator changed from unique_ptr to QSharedPointer and getPropagator() added with "// for the test" comment. Grep of test/ finds zero callers. Ownership semantics weakened for no consumer.

Fix: Revert to unique_ptr or add the test.
close_reason: done

title: Auth polling loop is CPU-wasteful and duplicated in 3 places
description:
FileProviderEnumerator.swift lines 98-115: waitForAuthentication uses a polling loop with Task.sleep at 500ms intervals. Same pattern duplicated in FileProviderExtension.swift at lines 469-474 and 547-551. The Int(elapsed) % 5 == 0 logging condition fires twice per 5-second boundary due to 0.5s interval.

Fix: Use a notification or async event instead of polling. Fix the modulus condition.
close_reason: Removed authentication polling loops. Missing credentials return notAuthenticated promptly; acknowledged setup signals the provider to resume enumeration. Immediate-auth-failure regression and signed initial/relaunch authentication checks passed.

title: OUT-OF-SCOPE: Singleton without Q_DISABLE_COPY
description:
fileprovider.h: FileProvider is a singleton (static instance()) with a private constructor but no Q_DISABLE_COPY macro. Minor — QObject already deletes copy ctor.

Fix: Add Q_DISABLE_COPY(FileProvider) for explicitness.
close_reason: Added explicit Q_DISABLE_COPY_MOVE(FileProvider) to the singleton. Desktop build passed.

title: Complete native Finder features and accurate on-demand sync status
description: User requested all public macOS Finder on-demand features: truthful sync status/progress/errors, download policies, Finder metadata, cloud search, remote thumbnails and native trash/restore. Preserve exclusive provider selection and stable signed-app Keychain access. Track supported/system-owned/private API distinctions in the feature matrix.
close_reason: Implemented public Finder capabilities and truthful domain-scoped sync status. Both universal extensions and desktop build; all 15 selected CTest suites and final signed Finder exercise pass. User confirmed exclusive mode switching and stable saved login. Live personal/Shares domains sync without warnings through multiple former reconnect intervals. Remaining conservative discarded-create error recovery tracked separately in bd-1c8.

title: Fix ARC bridging errors in .mm files
description: 4 void*/ObjC pointer casts need __bridge annotations under ARC: fileproviderdomainmanager_mac.mm:496, fileproviderxpc_mac.mm:400,435,446
close_reason: done

title: DRIFT: utility_unix.cpp refactoring unrelated to FileProvider VFS
description:
utility_unix.cpp refactors Linux desktop entry formatting. Unrelated to macOS FileProvider.

Fix: Split into a separate PR.
close_reason: Reverted unrelated Linux desktop-entry changes. utility_unix.cpp now has no diff against origin/main; final testutility passed.

title: Base64url decoding duplicated 3 times across 2 files
description:
FileProviderEnumerator.swift lines 149-155, 250-256 and FileProviderExtension.swift lines 277-285: Identical 5-line base64url decode block (replacingOccurrences, padding, Data base64Encoded) copy-pasted 3 times.

Fix: Extract to a shared String extension or utility function.
close_reason: Centralized path-identifier base64url decoding in WebDAVItem.swift and reused it from provider/enumerator code. Identity and enumeration regressions passed in final CTest.

title: Make macOS shipping scripts portable and fail on missing dependencies
description: tools/ship.sh contains machine-specific paths/signing defaults and warns on missing dylibs. Parameterize build/sign identities and fail before packaging when required runtime dependencies are absent. Test universal bundle linkage in CI; do not publish during verification.
notes: Reopened after full-client launch exposed stale Craft GUI library selection through embedded rpath, causing missing prepareForFolderSync. Root has updated resolver search precedence and QML staging; closure awaits the stale-library symbol regression and successful client relaunch.
close_reason: Current build dependencies take precedence over old Craft rpaths; 5 Mach-O tests and signed launch pass. Both extension default/override versions now match host versions, verified by universal Xcode builds. Packaging copies host metadata before signing.

comments.author: eli
comments.text: Reopened: Current-library packaging and launch verified. Follow-up live test found direct Xcode extension version metadata missing and macOS selected the older installed extension; version propagation fix in progress.
